Rosen

Exquisite Dining & World-Class Jazz
Apr 2026 • Couples
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at this place. The jazz playlist was curated perfectly and set the ideal mood. The atmosphere is cozy, and the food is delicious—the bo kho wonton was incredibly tender and paired beautifully with the carrot puree. Even the drinks were meticulously prepared, with great attention to detail in every glass. On top of that, the staff was exceptionally friendly and enthusiastic.
We spent our evening having dinner on the ground floor before heading up to the first floor for the jazz performance. The band was phenomenal; seeing them do a soundcheck/rehearsal before the show really proved how professional and dedicated they are.
I highly recommend experiencing dinner and live jazz here. It was truly a memorable night for us, and we will definitely be back!

An oasis for gourmets in the middle of Ho Chi Minh City, not to be missed...
Apr 2026 • Family
An oasis in the positively exciting Ho Chi Minh City. Reception and service extremely friendly, competent and courteous. This is exactly how we would like to be welcomed and accompanied !! Ambient with very well selected music extraordinarily special, very cool, well-groomed and welcoming. We were surprised with lady happy hour and a treasure chest... Menu small and fine, this speaks for the restaurant that focuses on quality and originality. We recommend the Bebop Wine Bar & Asian Fusion Restaurant based on our experience without reservation, for guests and gourmets looking for something special and extraordinary. We would come back to you anytime, bebop team, well done !!!
